prompt: Tell me about Philippo di Vadi
response: Philloppo di Vadi was a 15th-century Italian fencing master who wrote the treatise "De Arte Gladiatoria Dimicandi". He was known for his work with the sword and buckler and was influenced by the teachings of Fiore dei Liberi. Vadi's manuscript is notable for its detailed illustrations and explanations of fencing techniques. He was part of a lineage of fencing masters who contributed to the development of Italian fencing in the Renaissance period.
